stories.title: Nvidia CEO’s affair sparks Chinese espionage probe
stories.brief: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China.

stories.title: Trump defends Nvidia CEO amid Chinese spying allegations
stories.brief: Donald Trump has defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China.

stories.title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse
stories.brief: New figures suggest hazel dormice may be recovering after decades of decline, with warmer summers boosting survival.

stories.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy
stories.brief: Jensen Huang also admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and says he will cooperate with a security investigation.

stories.title: US chipmaker Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair

stories.title: PM raises youth loan amount, lowers minimum age limit
stories.brief: LAHORE: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has increased the limit of personal loans available under the Youth Business and Agriculture Loan schemes, and reduced the minimum age limit to allow 18-year-olds to avail the scheme as well.

stories.title: Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy
stories.brief: In a memo to the company, Huang admitted that he had an affair.

stories.title: Islamabad prepares for key ECO meeting
stories.brief: The regional security situation and simmering geopolitical tensions, which are hampering greater economic cooperation, are expected to feature prominently at the upcoming Economic Cooperation Organisation (ECO) Council of Ministers meeting in Islamabad on November 15-16.

stories.title: Pindi courts acquit most accused
stories.brief: The accused were convicted in 59 cases, while 114 ended in acquittals. Theft, vehicle theft and robbery The courts heard 2,664 cases of ordinary theft, resulting in 66 convictions, with each convicted accused receiving a three-year prison sentence.

stories.title: President, PM call for Iqbal-inspired national renewal
stories.brief: Meanwhile, PM Shehbaz announced the launch of year-long national and international commemorative activities, beginning on November 8 and culminating on November 9 next year, to promote Iqbal's intellectual legacy through academic, literary and cultural engagements.

stories.title: PML-N's Asif backs twelve new provinces
stories.brief: Minister for Defence Khawaja Asif has backed the idea of creating new administrative units in the country, but warned that such provinces should not be created on ethnic or political grounds.

stories.title: PML-N's Asad Hanif Jutt wins Chichawatni by-poll
stories.brief: Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) candidate Asad Hanif Jutt on Sunday won the by-election in Punjab Assembly constituency PP-203, defeating his closest rival, Muhammad Awais Mahmood Gujjar of Tehrik-e-Ehsas-e-Pakistan. The overall voter turnout remained around 28 per cent, despite a late surge in participation during the final three hours of polling.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz raises youth loan limit to Rs25m under business, agriculture schemes
stories.brief: The decision was taken at a meeting chaired by the prime minister to review the disbursement of loans to young people and the implementation of the two schemes.
